name: canvas-web-experiences
description: Design and build accessible Canvas, WebGL, WebGPU, and hybrid web experiences.

interface.longDescription: Plan, design, implement, and verify accessible Canvas, WebGL, WebGPU, spatial, map, diagram, and game web experiences with DOM fallbacks for experimental browser features.
defaultPrompt: Use $canvas-experience-orchestrator to plan and build a Canvas web experience.
Use $canvas-project-router to choose a Canvas architecture for this product.
Use $canvas-quality-audit to assess this Canvas experience in a browser.
